matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies that the unified actor loss in Section 4.2 (with β_div·L_div and β_dyn·L_dyn terms) is inconsistent with Appendix I.1/I.2 equations, which either place the diversity term in the critic loss or omit it entirely — this is the same cross-section inconsistency in the unified actor loss formulation that GT1 describes, just viewed from the opposite direction (added vs. omitted terms).

GT2 concerns inconsistent critic-update pseudocode (mean vs. min aggregation) across SAC-N, CQL, and EDAC implementations in the Appendix; Finding 2 instead discusses a dimensional-consistency issue in Appendix Eq. (5)'s value-target formula, an entirely different locus and mechanism, so it does not detect this defect.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the cross-section inconsistency in the unified actor loss definition between Section 4.2 and the Appendix equations.
Raises a plausible, specific dimensional-consistency concern about Eq. (5) that is not among the listed ground-truth defects (unrelated to the critic-update aggregation inconsistency).
